zh: 铜铃里留着海盐。守灯人曾摇它，告诉晚归的人岸就在前面。
en: Sea salt lingers inside the brass bell. The keeper once rang it to tell late boats that the shore was close.

zh: “今天又有一条船平安回家。”墨迹很淡，末尾画着一盏小灯。
en: “Another boat came safely home today.” The ink is faint. At the bottom is a drawing of a little lamp.

zh: 磨圆的扣子缝过许多次。夜里守灯的人，也有人惦记着冷不冷。
en: This worn button has been sewn back on many times. Someone worried whether the keeper would be warm enough at night.

zh: 杯底刻着每天添灯的记号。后来手慢了，记号也慢了。
en: Marks beneath the cup count the days the lamps were filled. Later, the hands grew slower, and so did the marks.

zh: 木船没有帆，船头朝着营地。有人把回家的方向做成了玩具。
en: The toy has no sail. Its bow points toward camp. Someone made the way home into a little boat.

zh: 盒子里只剩一段干灯芯。守灯人老了，有几盏灯来不及添。
en: Only a short, dry wick remains. The keeper grew old. Some lamps could no longer be tended in time.

zh: “等你们回来，一起把灯点上。”信没有写完，折痕却很温柔。
en: “When you return, we will light the lamps together.” The letter is unfinished, its folds carefully pressed.

zh: 石片上是两串脚印，朝着同一片星空。这里从来不是只等一个人。
en: Two trails of footprints face the same stars. This place was never waiting for just one person.

zh: 她先停下来看见了这朵小花。我们一起记下它的位置。
en: She was the first to stop and notice the flower. We marked its place together.

zh: 她说小洞里藏着月亮。贝壳的弧线果然很像。
en: She said there was a moon hidden in the little hollow. The shell really does curve like one.

zh: 她认出了这把修灯的小钳。照顾灯光，也是在照顾归来的人。
en: She recognized the little tool for mending lamps. Looking after a light means looking after those coming home.

zh: 她指着石上两个挨着的名字。风很轻，我们没有念出声。
en: She pointed to two names carved side by side. The wind was soft. We did not read them aloud.
